action.command:
set -a && . /workspace/.env && set +a
echo "=== all tables in formal_completeness_check with row counts ==="
for t in $(docker exec workspace-postgresql-1 psql -U postgres -d formal_completeness_check -tAc "SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public'"); do
  n=$(docker exec workspace-postgresql-1 psql -U postgres -d formal_completeness_check -tAc "SELECT count(*) FROM \"$t\"" 2>/dev/null)
  echo "$t=$n"
done
echo "=== administrative_file_draft VAE template ==="
for t in $(docker exec workspace-postgresql-1 psql -U postgres -d administrative_file_draft -tAc "SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public'"); do
  n=$(docker exec workspace-postgresql-1 psql -U postgres -d administrative_file_draft -tAc "SELECT count(*) FROM \"$t\"" 2>/dev/null)
  echo "$t=$n"
done
